BiblicalUsage: Shobak was the captain of Hadarezer's army, the Syrian commander David faced at Helam. The Syrians fled before Israel, and David slew the men of the chariots and the horsemen, and smote Shobak himself, who died there on the field.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God settles the wars men start. Shobak led a great host against Israel, and I hold that no captain, however seasoned, outlasts the Lord's purpose.
